name: certified-f32-viterbi
hypothesis: Use float32 only for the Viterbi recurrence over unchanged exact f64 state/state-transition scores, certify every selected edge and final label with the 152-style propagated error bound, and fall back to original f64 Viterbi whenever unsupported or inconclusive.

release.flags: clang; existing 119 switches plus -DEXP_CERT_F32_VITERBI; -O2 -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math; scanner -O0; profile mode none; no LTO or PGO

diagnostic.reason: Release has no operation counters. benchmark_186 may add minimal cert/fallback counters in its separate derivative; release source and binary are immutable.

unavailable.certified_addresses_and_fallbacks: No diagnostic-only counter in this immutable release; benchmark worker can add one in an isolated diagnostic derivative.
unavailable.construction_bytes_and_allocation_counts: Not instrumented in the decoder-only candidate.

supersedes: raw/handoff-v1.json (rejected after code review: M did not include an explicit upper bound for rounding growth of intermediates)
